title: R-linear functor
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be $R$-linear categories [def-weil-linear-category]. An *$R$-linear functor* is a functor $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ such that for all objects $x,y$ of $\mathcal A$ the map $F:\Hom_{\mathcal A}(x,y)\to\Hom_{\mathcal B}(F(x),F(y))$ is a homomorphism of $R$-modules: $F(f+g)=F(f)+F(g)$ and $F(af)=aF(f)$ for $a\in R$.
